prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: a complete 1536x1024 Today screen for the existing Chinese companion app 在场. The only input is a CLEAN EMPTY ROOM photograph-like illustration, used solely as the room, camera, furniture and light reference. There is no product screenshot and no previous UI design as input. Preserve the complete beautiful wood window, curtains, small side table and seat. Let at least 40% of this room remain visible and emotionally present. Primary request: a humane university day held within reach, clear calendar facts and generous unfilled time, Apple-like quiet precision with the light and paper organically belonging to the room. This is an app, not a photo of a computer or a literal giant paper board stuck in the room. Stable transparent app top navigation: 在场 left, 聊天 今天 留下 centered with 今天 selected; search, small character-free circle and ellipsis right. Header 今天 and small 10月26日 周一 sits at the normal content left anchor, a compact quiet previous/date/next control beside it, 回到对话 at the right content anchor. Avoid a solid full-width header card. One calm vertical timeline occupies the left 55–60%, from 08:00 to 20:00; only event objects have warm paper, with an extremely light continuous milk-ivory reading veil behind the thin time axis and labels so text is readable. No big opaque square sheet, no framed board, no blank white sidebar, no heavy blurry curtain across the room. Room detail and window light continue through the empty periods without obscuring the words. Draw mathematically coherent time placement: 高等数学 09:00–10:15 in quiet mist blue, a slim preparation/transition strip 换教室 10:15–10:30, 线性代数 10:30–11:45 also blue, 午饭 12:00–13:00 in warm neutral, 复习常微分方程 14:00–15:30 in soft golden paper, 和朋友吃饭 18:00–19:00 held steady in soft apricot. Event card heights and starts match real hour ticks; no arrows, no duplicate study card, no fake ghost placed at another hour. The spaces 13:00–14:00 and 15:30–18:00 remain truly empty, not opportunities to fill with more tasks. A single selected study card carries a very small paper-corner action near its own edge, “换个时间”; clicking that is the product's real entry to trial, it does not create a second calendar. On the right-lower portion, comfortably in the space above the seat, one small current-object paper note opens with “复习常微分方程” and a simple single editable row “14:00 — 15:30”; below a quiet same-owner link “一起商量”, one ordinary “保存” and a text “先放下”. This note is a draft, no success receipt and no made-up planning conclusion. Keep it small, about 300 pixels wide, visually related to the selected event. Most of the right half remains the existing window seat, lamp and room, with no large character or invented portrait. Top near the timeline has just a subtle plus “记一件事”; all administrative filters, completed/all/todo lists and export live behind one restrained ellipsis, not rows of buttons. No second chat input on Today. Typography must be precise, dark warm ink, clear practical size, natural Chinese. Event titles, time and route-like sources remain real future native text, not burned image controls. Minimum borders, soft single shadow on lifted objects, no green UI, no glass on glass, no cold gray blocks, no achievements, streaks, progress rings, graph dashboards, engineering state or explanatory labels. Warmth comes from keeping lunch, dinner and breathing room as real priorities. The room is ONE continuous space, no day/night split or hard separating rails.
